summary: City Council, on November 7, 8, and 9, 2017, adopted Item MM34.35, and in so doing, has requested the Board of Health to hold public hearings on the dangers of nuclear weapons and radiation fallout.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Government of Canada to sign the United Nations Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons.

text: City Council, on November 7, 8, and 9, 2017, adopted Item MM34.35, and in so doing, has requested the Board of Health to hold public hearings on the dangers of nuclear weapons and radiation fallout.
City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Government of Canada to sign the United Nations Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons.
